title: Macaronic
summary: MACARON'IC, adjective Pertaining to or like a macaroni; empty; trifling; vain; affected. 1. Consisting of a mixture or jumble of ill formed or ill connected words. MACARON'IC, noun A kind of burlesque

inlines.v: MACARON'IC, adjective Pertaining to or like a macaroni; empty; trifling; vain; affected. 1. Consisting of a mixture or jumble of ill formed or ill connected words. MACARON'IC, noun A kind of burlesque poetry, in which native words are made to end in Latin terminations, or Latin words are modernized.
